capability_statement: AOF can convert raw provider-read evidence into a human-readable replay that states what was read, why it mattered, what changed, and what remains unproven.
before_state: Provider evidence was auditable but still required operators to connect raw JSON artifacts manually.
after_state: Provider evidence is replayed in one operator-readable packet with no-write and not-proven boundaries.
scenario: A reviewer asks what GitHub provider state influenced a release decision; inspect POR-TASK-136-V115 instead of reading multiple raw artifacts.
five_minute_demo: Run provider-observation-replay-audit and open POR-TASK-136-V115.json; confirm what_was_read, why_it_mattered, what_changed, not_proven, and next_action.
time_saved_or_work_reduced: Reduces manual provider-evidence reconstruction for release review.
cognitive_load_removed: The operator no longer has to infer what provider evidence means or whether it authorizes writes.

capability_matrix.user_value: understand provider evidence and proof limits without raw JSON reconstruction

not_proven: This does not prove provider semantic truth, credential safety, GitHub write safety, production automation, market value, productivity gain, or broad adoption.
